headline: Alphabet Reports Cloud Growth Alongside Higher Cash Burn and Debt Issuance
summary: Alphabet reported significant growth in Google Cloud, but overall earnings fell short of expectations, leading the company to increase cash burn and resort to debt financing.
why: Big tech capital expenditures on artificial intelligence and cloud infrastructure require heavy upfront investments that can temporarily impact near-term earnings.

impacts.name: Alphabet Inc
impacts.why: Earnings falling short of consensus estimates combined with increased cash burn led to immediate downward pressure on the stock.

why_moved: Disappointing profit figures and higher capital expenditures for cloud and AI infrastructure than anticipated led to a sharp drop in share price.
